items.title: SENATOROVAI/stochastic-average-gradient-sag-saga-solver-course
items.abstract: The SAG (Stochastic Average Gradient) + SAGA (Accelerated) solver is an optimization algorithm used primarily in machine learning, specifically for logistic regression and linear support vector machines (SVMs) within libraries like scikit-learn. It is designed to be highly efficient for large datasets with many samples and features. Solver
